name: DR Congo (east)
value: Kivu and Ituri fighting; no city fallen
summary: Clashes in Ituri's Djugu disrupt the Ebola response on 25 Nov; Kivu fighting continues; no major city falls
state: Radio Okapi reported on 25 Nov that clashes in Djugu, Ituri, are disrupting the Ebola response, and civil society warned of precarious conditions for 175,000 displaced people in Mwenga, South Kivu. An ISS analysis on 23 Nov said M23 has stepped up drone use since July around Minembwe, where the army and allied militias are fighting the Kabila-led FRN coalition. No major city has fallen and no direct interstate fighting is confirmed as of 25 Nov, so Watch holds.
for_you: Civilians in North and South Kivu and Ituri face displacement, armed-group attacks and disrupted health services, including the Ebola response. FCDO advises against all travel to the eastern provinces.
rubric_hit: Watch: active fighting in South Kivu and Ituri; no major city captured and no confirmed interstate fighting

sources.title: Radio Okapi — Ituri : les affrontements à Djugu perturbent la riposte contre Ebola

why: A long war over mineral-rich territory, drawing in Rwanda and threatening a wider Great Lakes conflict.
drivers: M23/AFC advances, Rwanda involvement, peace deals, mineral trade.
